name: Republic of Crimea
#why: The Republic of Crimea, a subject of Russia under the Russian Constitution, art. 65(1), as a card in Russia's first level (ruled 2026-10-08 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). Its code is GOST 7.67-2024's three-letter code, Russia's own standard (wiki:ru:306293@155351948), since its two-letter RU-KR is ISO's Karelia. Its ground is Ukraine's UA-43 card as drawn, geoBoundaries' oblast cut to land, and must cover Simferopol, 34.1024 E 44.9521 N. Russia holds it, so its ground is drawn as held, under the rule that fill follows the ground (ruled 2026-10-08 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)).

name: Sevastopol

name: Donetsk People's Republic

name: Taiwan Province
#why: Taiwan Province, a province-level division in the People's Republic of China's own list (gov.cn, web:ca9db1c0ddd9763c), as a card in China's first level under ISO 3166-2:CN's own code CN-TW (ruled 2026-10-08 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). Its ground is the TWN card's outline less Kinmen (near Jincheng, 118.3171 E 24.4329 N) and Matsu (near Nangan, 119.9447 E 26.1597 N), both Fujian's in the PRC's division: parts within 20 km of either point are left out (Kinmen's two islands lie within 12 km of Jincheng, Penghu 160 km away), and Natural Earth's TWN draws Kinmen and no Matsu. It must cover Taipei, 121.5654 E 25.0330 N. The PRC does not hold it, so its ground is drawn as claimed.

name: Guayana Esequiba
#why: Guayana Esequiba, a state of Venezuela under the Organic Law for the Defence of Guayana Esequiba, 2024, art. 9, as a card in Venezuela's first level (ruled 2026-10-08 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). Its code VE-GE is minted, two letters outside the register's one-letter Venezuelan scheme, so no later ISO code can collide with it. Its ground is Natural Earth's disputed polygon B56, the land west of the Essequibo River, the law's eastern limit (143,339 km2 against the cited 159,500), which must cover Mabaruma, 59.78 W 8.20 N. Venezuela does not hold it, so its ground is drawn as claimed.
